title: Residential Electricity Supply Renewal Loyalty Credit: Amount Basis
content:
**Basis.** The renewal loyalty credit on a Residential Electricity Supply agreement is the renewal loyalty credit of the plan renewed into, rounded half up to the cent. The plan's figure is the one the dual-fuel and renewal loyalty credit rate card states for the plan the agreement renewed into, the plan recorded on the agreement for its current term.

**Assembly and rounding.** Multipliers act successively on the plan loyalty credit, each on the amount the previous one reached; flat bonuses are added to that product; the total is rounded half up to the cent only once, at the end, and posted as a negative amount.

## Illustrations (hypothetical renewals)

| Plan renewed into | Plan loyalty credit on the rate card | Renewal loyalty credit |
|---|---|---|
| a plan whose card figure is 25.00 USD | 25.00 | 25.00 USD, posted as minus 25.00 USD |
| a plan whose card figure is 50.00 USD | 50.00 | 50.00 USD, posted as minus 50.00 USD |
| a plan whose card figure is 0.00 USD | 0.00 | none earned |

**Successive multipliers (hypothetical).** A plan loyalty credit of 25.00 USD with a first multiplier of 1.3 reaches 32.50 USD; a second multiplier of 1.3 then acts on 32.50 USD and reaches 42.25 USD. Rounding happens only on the final total.
